+import json

+
+import duckdb

+OUT = Path("out")

+    f"""

+    GROUP BY period
+    """

+

+summary["period"] = summary["period"].astype(str)
+summary["injury_crash_pct"] = summary["injury_crashes"] / summary["crashes"] * 100
+summary["fatal_crash_pct"] = summary["fatal_crashes"] / summary["crashes"] * 100

+

+    positions = range(len(values))
+    bars = ax.bar(positions, values, color=colors, width=0.58)
+    ax.set_xticks(list(positions), labels)
+    ax.set_ylabel(axis_label, labelpad=10)
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=17, weight="bold", pad=16)
+    ax.text(0, 1.015, subtitle, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10, color="#555555")
+    ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#BBBBBB")

+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#E8E8E8", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    max_value = max(values)

+    for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
+        text = f"{value:.2f}%" if percent else f"{value:,.0f}"

+                text, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=12, weight="bold")
+    fig.text(0.01, 0.015,

+    fig.savefig(OUT / filename, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")

+count_values["window_hours_per_day"] = 12

+)
+

+    "Fatal crashes were more common among nighttime reports",

+            "probability": 0.45,
+            "answer": f"Fatal crashes made up {night['fatal_crash_pct']:.3f}% of nighttime reports versus {day['fatal_crash_pct']:.3f}% of daytime reports, about {fatal_ratio:.1f} times the daytime share."

- Fatal crashes accounted for 0.245% of nighttime reports versus 0.101% of daytime reports—about 2.4 times the daytime share ([chart](out/option_3.png)). These figures compare outcomes per reported crash, not risk per trip or mile.
